title: Rainbow Six Siege
source: built-in R6 Siege (2025 HUD) preset, calibrated on full frames of a 1080p stream; moved from regions.py unchanged
notes: killfeed: right-aligned rows at x~1590-1830, newest row at y~296, older rows stacking upward ~32 px apart. Blue name boxes = own team, orange = enemy. 'Reverse Friendly Fire has been activated for X' appears here too. min_change is low: the grey 'Reverse Friendly Fire' row changes the mask by only ~1.4% of the region (measured).
banner: round banner ('WON ROUND 5', 'VICTORY'), centre, x~650-1250, y~430-540.
notice: 'OPFOR last op standing.', centre, y~765-795.
builtin: the original R6 interpretation (coloured name boxes, HUD-colour mask gate); banner_phrases are used as listed, without the generic banners, and the OCR cache key has no preset fields.
hype: hype: 0-1 walking/waiting, menus, loading, operator select, scoreboard, killcam, replay; 3-4 a single ordinary kill; 6-7 a round win, a multi-kill, a close fight; 8-10 a clutch (1 vs many), an ace, a spectacular kill.
